instruction: A candid studio portrait photograph, captured in a three-quarter medium shot at eye level. In a minimalist indoor photo studio with a seamless white background, the red-haired woman in the blue shirt (R2) stands on the left holding a wire basket of vegetables in her right hand, looking towards her friend with a warm, joyful smile. Beside her on the right, the curly-haired woman in the green crop top (R1) stands holding a silver water bottle with both hands in front of her chest, looking back at her friend with a pleasant smile. The red-haired woman (R2) rests her left arm over the curly-haired woman's (R1) right shoulder as they stand close together. The scene is illuminated by bright, even studio lighting with soft shadows, creating a clean white and pastel color palette.
